candidates.title: Burnaby Youth Soccer Association (BYSA) recreational league
candidates.description: BYSA runs seasonal outdoor soccer leagues for school-age children across Burnaby, typically organized by age group. A natural fit for a child who loves soccer and team sports.
candidates.coverageNote: Well-established community soccer association in Burnaby; specific season registration windows should be confirmed at bysa.ca.

candidates.title: Burnaby Parks & Recreation indoor soccer drop-in
candidates.description: Burnaby's community recreation centres (e.g. Bonsor, Edmonds, Eileen Dailly) regularly offer indoor soccer or multi-sport drop-in sessions for school-age kids. Great for casual, no-registration play.
candidates.coverageNote: Drop-in sport programs are a standing feature of Burnaby rec centres; schedules vary by centre and term — check burnaby.ca/recreation.

candidates.title: Burnaby FC development soccer program
candidates.description: Burnaby FC offers youth development programming for children interested in improving their soccer skills beyond recreational play, including skills clinics and club training sessions.
candidates.coverageNote: Club-level soccer is well-established in Burnaby; confirm current intake and age-group availability directly with Burnaby FC.

candidates.title: Burnaby Parks & Recreation multi-sport after-school program
candidates.description: City recreation centres in Burnaby run structured after-school and weekend multi-sport programs covering soccer, basketball, and flag football — ideal for a sports-loving child who wants variety.
candidates.coverageNote: Multi-sport programs are a typical seasonal offering at Burnaby rec centres; verify current session availability at burnaby.ca/recreation.

candidates.title: Burnaby community park free kick-around (Swangard Stadium area / Central Park)
candidates.description: Central Park in Burnaby has large open fields and is adjacent to Swangard Stadium, making it a popular informal spot for families to kick a soccer ball around any day of the week — no registration needed.
candidates.coverageNote: Central Park is a well-known, publicly accessible green space in Burnaby suitable for free outdoor play year-round.

candidates.title: Burnaby School District community school sports nights
candidates.description: Several Burnaby community schools host open gym and sport nights for neighbourhood children through the Community Schools program, often including soccer and other team sports.
candidates.coverageNote: Community school evening programs exist across Burnaby but vary widely by school and semester — confirm at burnaby.sd41.bc.ca.

candidates.title: Lower Mainland soccer skills camp (summer)
candidates.description: Each summer, multiple organizations in Burnaby and neighbouring municipalities run week-long soccer skills camps for school-age children, often held at local high school fields or recreation facilities.
candidates.coverageNote: Summer soccer camps are a reliable annual offering across Burnaby; specific providers and dates should be checked as summer approaches.
